Food delivery websites should make you hungry within the first three seconds. 🍗

For EATLY, we designed a full food delivery homepage anchored by "Enjoy Your Delicious Food" in bold serif type, paired with real, mouth-watering chicken wing photography instead of illustrated icons. A floating "30 Min Delivery" badge and a real customer review card "Arefin Shuvo, Fast delivery at home, 5 stars" sit directly on the hero image, building trust and urgency without a single extra scroll.

Stats below the fold do the rest of the convincing: 500K+ meals served, 4.9/5 average rating, 200+ curated recipes from top chefs, 98% satisfaction. Clean navigation and a clear "Order Now" CTA keep the whole experience frictionless from the first glance.

We design conversion-focused websites for food delivery apps, restaurants, and hospitality brands across London, New York, and Amsterdam where appetite-driven design directly impacts orders.

Real estate investment platforms need a website that feels as premium as the properties they list. 🏡

For Breeze, we designed a full investment property website anchored by "Smart Real Estate Investment," paired with a moody, cinematic hero shot of a modern glass villa set against misty mountains. "Every Week There Is A Set For Two Tours" adds a subtle urgency detail directly into the hero, turning a static headline into an active invitation.

"Modeler's Haven" showcases real listings with named agents (Lila Bennett, Ella Thompson), professional photography, and verified floor plans building the exact trust a buyer needs before committing serious capital. Property cards throughout carry consistent framing, real customer feedback, and an FAQ section closes any remaining hesitation before "Let's Build Your Dream House."

We design portfolio and platform websites for real estate investment firms, property developers, and proptech startups across London, New York, and Amsterdam.
